bias.en: Bearish, improving · gave back the Oct 29 gain, on the 10-day
bias.zh: 偏空、改善中 · 回吐 10月29日涨幅，回到 10 日均线

read.en: MP fell 5.0% on Oct 30 to $39.57 (range $38.49–40.34) after a 1.4% gain on Oct 29. It is just below the rising 5-day ($40.12), on the falling 10-day ($39.50) and below the falling 30-day ($43.89), 100-day ($49.79) and 200-day ($55.21). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram flattening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($37.41), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: MP 10月30日下跌 5.0%，收于 $39.57（区间 $38.49–40.34），此前 10月29日上涨 1.4%。股价略低于上行的 5 日均线（$40.12），位于下行的 10 日均线（$39.50）上，并低于下行的 30 日（$43.89）、100 日（$49.79）和 200 日均线（$55.21）。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图走平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$37.41），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The Oct 29 high of $42.54 reversed at the $42.5 Oct 16 high; Oct 30 slipped under the 5-day but held $39.5. Resistance is $40.1–40.3 (5-day, Oct 30 high), then $41.6–42.5 (Oct 29 close and highs) and $43.9–44.5 (30-day, Oct 1 low). Support is $38.5–39.5, then $37.4–38.0 (SAR, Oct 27 low) and $37.1 (52-week low). A close above $40.3 would target $41.6–42.5; below $38.5, $37.1–38.

r.en: Oct 29 close $41.64; Oct 16 and Oct 29 highs ($42.51–42.54)
